questions.q: What is Meridian Outfitters' core database, and what does it hold?
options: MeridianCommerce — orders, customers, inventory, and product catalog
MERSQLPRD01 — a database named after the server it runs on
AG-Meridian — a reporting-only data warehouse
MeridianDBAOps — the automation scripts themselves stored as a database
questions.explain: MeridianCommerce is the database; MERSQLPRD01 is the instance it runs on, AG-Meridian is the availability group, and MeridianDBAOps is the PowerShell automation suite, not a database.

questions.q: What are the three specific manual habits this capstone sets out to eliminate?
options: Backups run by hand, morning health checks done by eyeball in SSMS, and schema changes deployed from emailed scripts
Writing T-SQL, installing SQL Server, and configuring Windows updates
Hiring more DBAs, buying more hardware, and switching database platforms
Nothing manual — Priya's routine was already fully automated before this capstone
questions.explain: Those three concrete, error-prone habits are the exact target this capstone's automation suite replaces.

questions.q: What real incident resulted from the manual backup habit?
options: A disk failure required restoring from a backup over 36 hours old, after Priya forgot to run a manual backup before a long weekend
A schema change was deployed to the wrong server
An index rebuild locked the production database for six hours
No incident ever occurred — the manual process was reliable
questions.explain: Twice in the past year, forgetting a manual backup before a long weekend caused a restore from a stale backup after a disk failure.

questions.q: Which SQL Server instance is the primary replica of AG-Meridian, hosting MeridianCommerce in production?
options: MERSQLPRD01
MERSQLPRD02
MERSQLDEV01
MERBACKUP01
questions.explain: MERSQLPRD01 is production and the AG's primary replica; MERSQLPRD02 is the secondary, MERSQLDEV01 is dev/test, and MERBACKUP01 is only the backup file share.

questions.q: Which earlier chapters' patterns does Lesson 38 (building the automation suite) apply directly to Meridian Outfitters?
options: Chapters 1-2 — PowerShell/dbatools scripting patterns for DBA work
Chapters 3-4 — source control and CI/CD
Chapter 5 — infrastructure as code
Chapter 6 — monitoring and alerting
questions.explain: Lesson 38 builds the actual backup, health-check, and maintenance scripts using Chapters 1-2's dbatools/scripting foundations; source control, CI/CD, and monitoring come in later capstone lessons.
